name: 118 SP
desc: Herkner’s “Offenbach chair” reduces the wooden chair to its fewest elements, a principle Michael Thonet set in the 1850s. Legs rounded outside and straight inside echo the horseshoe seat. Shown as 118 M with a plywood seat; also with canework.
dims: W 42 · D 50 · H 80 cm · Seat H 46
materials: Bent beech · Plywood or cane seat
